# Getting help with Norconex Crawlers

## Questions and usage help

Configuration, "how do I...", "why does it...", and v3-to-v4 migration
questions belong in **[Q&A Discussions][qa]**. Search first — many are already
answered.

## Bugs

A reproducible defect — wrong output, a crash, a stack trace, a build or
packaging failure — goes in the **[issue tracker][issues]** via the **Bug
report** form. During the v4 beta, add the **V4** label so it isn't mixed in
with v3 reports.

## Feature ideas

Propose and discuss features in **[Ideas Discussions][ideas]**. Vote for
existing proposals with a 👍 reaction rather than a "+1" comment — that is how
maintainers gauge demand. Accepted ideas are promoted to issues.

## Security

Do not open a public issue or discussion. See **[SECURITY.md][security]**.

## Commercial support

Norconex offers paid support with response-time commitments and custom
development: <https://crawler.norconex.com/support>.
